title.en: An Act to Convert the Tolong High School in the Municipality of Sta. Catalina, Province of Negros Oriental, to a National Rural School
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Tolong High School in the Municipality of Sta. Catalina, Province of Negros Oriental, to a National Rural School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1950/ra_561_1950.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 条号自第 2 条起而非自 1 起（止于第 3 条）：本法为“修改型法条”，仅重述被修改的个别条文，条号承被修改法之后，属该体例使然。

text.en: The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the operation and maintenance of the said school for the fiscal year ending June thirty, nineteen hundred fifty-one. Thereafter, the necessary sum for said purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 17, 1950.
